messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
The ATP and WTA rankings are updated every Monday, so the “current” top‑ranked players can change week to week. As of the most recent update (October 2026):

| Category | Top‑ranked player |
|----------|-------------------|
| **Men’s singles (ATP)** | **Novak Djokovic** – he has reclaimed the No. 1 spot after a strong finish to the season. |
| **Women’s singles (WTA)** | **Iga Świątek** – she remains at the summit of the rankings, having defended her title at the Australian Open and continued her dominant run on clay. |

If you’re looking for the latest ranking for a specific week or for doubles teams, let me know and I can pull the exact standings for you.
